𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗮𝗱𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗿𝘆 𝗶𝘀𝘀𝘂𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗿𝗲-𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗨𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗕𝗵𝗮𝗴𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗵 𝗮𝘁 𝗞𝗼𝘁𝗹𝗮 𝗩𝗶𝗷𝗮𝘆𝗮 𝗕𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗲𝗿 𝗥𝗲𝗱𝗱𝘆 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗱𝗶𝘂𝗺 𝗼𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 𝟭𝟱.

Hyderabad Traffic Police inform that traffic congestion is expected on March 15 from 3 PM to 10 PM due to the pre-release event of Ustaad Bhagat Singh at the Police Grounds, 1st Battalion near Kotla Vijaya Bhasker Reddy Stadium, Yousufguda. A large number of people are expected to attend the event. Commuters are advised to avoid roads towards the stadium and use alternative routes.

𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:

Traffic from Jubilee Hills Check Post towards KVBR Stadium will be diverted at Krishna Nagar Junction towards Srinagar Colony – Panjagutta.

Traffic from Maitrivanam Junction towards Jubilee Hills Check Post / Madhapur will be diverted at Yousufguda Basti towards RBI Quarters – Krishna Nagar Junction – Jubilee Hills Check Post.

Traffic from Maitrivanam Junction towards Borabanda Bus Stop will be diverted via Savera Function Hall – Krishnakanth Park – GTS Temple – Kalyan Nagar – Moti Nagar – Borabanda Bus Stop.

Traffic from Borabanda Bus Stop towards Maitrivanam Junction will be diverted via Prime Garden Kalyan Nagar – Midland Bakery – GTS Colony – Kalyan Nagar Junction – Umesh Chandra Statue U-Turn – ICICI U-Turn – Maitrivanam Junction.

𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗔𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀:

Janakammathota Parking, Yousufguda – 2 & 4 wheelers

Metro Parking, Yousufguda – 2 & 4 wheelers

Savera Function Hall, Yousufguda – 4 wheelers only

Mahamood Function Hall, Yousufguda – 4 wheelers only
